$comment: The shadcn/ui source each component was adapted from. The file named by `upstream` is that source, unmodified, so that a later upstream change can be compared with it and merged by hand. A component written without a shadcn/ui source has `upstream: null` and says why under `none`. packages/web/test/shadcn.test.js checks this file.

toast.none: The registry has no toast on Radix: https://ui.shadcn.com/r/styles/new-york-v4/toast.json is not found, and its sonner component depends on the sonner and next-themes packages. The Toast is written on Radix's Toast primitive instead (rfcs/0008-toast.md).
